description: Ascona’s promenade follows Lake Maggiore past a tight row of colored houses and the church campanile, with palms along the quay and mountains across the water. The town is the compact Maggiore waterfront, not the Lugano bay and not Piazza Grande, and no readable shop signs or boat names are featured. Late-September vegetation is still green. The Open-Meteo model sets the light.
